description: A signer is a public key this tenant trusts to vouch for update artifacts: an artifact signed by an active signer is trusted, one without is unverified. Only the public key is stored here; the private key stays with whoever signs.
fieldNameHint: A label to recognise this signer by, such as the team or build pipeline that holds the key.
fieldPublicKeyHint: One SPKI public key block, ECDSA P-256 or Ed25519. Paste the public half only.
guideLink: How to generate a key and compute its key ID
privateKeyRefused: That looks like a private key, so nothing was sent and the field was cleared. Register only the public half of a key pair.
registerDescription: Trust a public key to sign update artifacts.
revokePinned: Update assignments already sent keep the signature they were pinned with.
revokeUnverified_one: {{count, number}} artifact has no other active signer and becomes UNVERIFIED.
revokeUnverified_other: {{count, number}} artifacts have no other active signer and become UNVERIFIED.
title: Signers
